'''Winsafra Cloud City is MINE, all MINE, mwahahahaha. now leave before i kill you all!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 7 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]

* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Deal Winsafra DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

Admirals and generals control cloud city, nuff said

== Strategy ==

basically, use troopers and the executor, and admirals and generals to completely control cloud city. use the vaders(and soon to be maul's) with lightsabers to scare them away from the carbon chamber( everybodys scared of all too easy :P) other than that, its up to you
